sections.heading: Common ADA Door Repairs We Handle
sections.body: ADA door systems involve more components than a standard door, and any one of them can fail over time. Our technicians are experienced in repairing and replacing a wide range of hardware and glass elements that affect door accessibility and performance. We service hydraulic and pneumatic door closers that control swing speed and force, ensuring doors open with the appropriate level of resistance. We repair and recalibrate automatic door operators, replace worn push-button activation panels, and address hardware issues with panic bars and lever-style handles. On the glass side, we replace cracked or shattered glass panels in door lites, sidelites, and full-glass door assemblies. We also address threshold adjustments and weather stripping that can create tripping hazards or reduce ease of entry. Every repair is approached with attention to functionality and the safety needs of all users.

sections.heading: Residential ADA Door Repair for Alexandria Homeowners
sections.body: Accessibility upgrades and repairs are not limited to commercial properties. Many Alexandria homeowners modify their entryways to accommodate family members with mobility challenges or to age-in-place with greater independence. Residential ADA door repairs may include adjusting or replacing door closers for smoother operation, installing or repairing lever-style hardware, addressing threshold issues, and replacing glass in doors that have been modified for visibility or width compliance. Our team approaches residential jobs with the same professionalism and attention to detail we bring to commercial sites. Whether your home is a classic rowhouse in the Seminary Hill neighborhood or a newer townhome near the waterfront, we can assess your door system and recommend the right repair strategy to restore function and ease of access for every household member.
